{{Quote|Take a look behind yourself Sith, that's what two squads of the Republic's finest look like.''"<br />"''Finally, a fight worthy of me!|Zixx and the [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]]|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Zixx''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] who served as a prison operative of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in its illegal operations on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Zixx guarded a Republic prisoner named [[Durmat]], who spontaneously admitted that his father, Commander [[Rylon (spy)|Rylon]] was an Imperial spy. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] as he attempted to stop the [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]] from executing the prisoner.
